column1: # rpms-ux scenarios, from docs/product-cycle/STORIES.md at commit 7f076114c7126241b12c06f790a10bc93ea70442
# generated by bin/bprm_scenarios; regenerate after rpms-ux changes, do not edit

column6: given
column8: then

column6: a patient already registered at the facility
column7: I search by last name and date of birth
column8: the patient is listed with their health record number and I can open their registration

column6: no patient matches
column8: I am offered to add a new patient

column6: a patient whose chart at this facility is inactive or deleted
column8: the patient is listed with that chart status, so I do not mistake them for an active patient

column6: a deceased patient
column8: the patient is listed as deceased

column6: a patient registered at another facility and not at this one
column8: I am asked for a health record number at this facility before anything else, and until one is filed in the HEALTH RECORD NO. multiple (#9000001.41) of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) the record cannot be edited here

column6: I have the patient open at the front desk
column7: I send them to the EHR
column8: the patient context for my user is set to this patient, so the EHR on my workstation opens on them

column6: no existing chart
column7: I enter name, sex, date of birth, tribe of membership and community of residence and save
column8: the patient exists in PATIENT (#2) and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) with a health record number for this facility

column6: a required field is missing
column8: the registration is refused and names the field

column6: a patient already on file with the same name, date of birth and sex
column7: I enter the new patient's name, date of birth and sex
column8: I am shown the possible matches, with their chart numbers, before anything is filed, and I can open one of them instead of registering

column6: a name that is not `LAST,FIRST MIDDLE`, or shorter than 3 or longer than 30 characters
column8: the registration is refused and names the format

column6: a date of birth in the future, or before 1871
column8: the registration is refused

column6: no social security number and no reason for having none
column8: the registration is refused and asks for the reason

column6: a social security number that is not nine digits
column8: the registration is refused and names the format

column6: a social security number already on another patient in PATIENT (#2)
column8: the registration is refused and nothing is filed

column6: a health record number already assigned to another patient at this facility, in any of its leading-zero or temporary forms
column8: the registration is refused and names the number

column6: a health record number that is not 1 to 6 characters in the chart-number format
column8: the registration is refused

column6: I have not said whether the patient received the notice of privacy practices, or whether they are a veteran
column8: the registration is refused and names what is missing

column6: this facility's REGISTRATION PARAMETERS (#9009061) make the street address, city, state or zip code mandatory
column7: I save without one of them
column8: the registration is refused and names the field

column6: no primary language, or no community of residence and date moved there
column8: the registration is refused and names the value

column6: a complete registration
column8: IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds today as the date established and me as the establishing user and the user of the last update, and the patient's registration event is raised for the packages that listen for it

column6: I hold none of the keys that allow registering a patient (AGZMGR, AGZMENU, XUPROG, XUPROGMODE)
column8: I cannot add a patient

column6: a registered patient with Medicaid
column7: I add the Medicaid number and eligibility dates
column8: the eligibility shows on the patient and is in force on today's date

column6: eligibility that has lapsed
column8: I am warned before the visit is created

column6: a patient whose record is marked sensitive
column7: I open them and accept that I have a need to know
column8: the record opens and DG SECURITY LOG (#38.1) holds my access to the patient with the date, my user and the registration option

column6: a patient whose record is marked sensitive
column8: the record does not open and nothing is logged

column6: a patient whose record is my own
column8: I am refused and the record does not open

column6: a patient I am restricted from, or my own user has no social security number on file
column8: I am refused and told why, and the record does not open

column6: a patient whose record is marked for a warning only
column8: I am warned and the record opens without a log entry

column5: Register a patient quickly from scheduling
column6: a caller with no chart
column7: I enter name, date of birth, sex and social security number and ask for a chart number to be generated
column8: the patient exists in PATIENT (#2) and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) with me as the user who entered them, and the HEALTH RECORD NO. multiple (#9000001.41) holds a temporary number for this facility

column5: Register a patient quickly from scheduling
column6: a caller with no chart and a chart number I have been given
column7: I enter it instead of asking for one
column8: the HEALTH RECORD NO. multiple (#9000001.41) holds that number for this facility

column5: Register a patient quickly from scheduling
column6: a patient already on file with the same name, date of birth and sex
column8: I am shown the possible matches and can pick one to book instead of registering again

column5: Register a patient quickly from scheduling
column6: no social security number and no reason for having none, or a number already on another patient
column8: it is refused and nothing is filed

column5: Register a patient quickly from scheduling
column6: a chart number already assigned to another patient at this facility
column8: it is refused and names the number

column5: Register a patient quickly from scheduling
column6: I do not hold the scheduling registration key (SDZREGMENU)
column7: I search and find no match
column8: I am not offered to register the caller

column5: Give a patient from another facility a chart here
column6: a patient with a chart at another facility and none at this one
column7: I add a health record number for this facility
column8: the HEALTH RECORD NO. multiple (#9000001.41) of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the number under this facility, and the other facility's number is unchanged

column5: Give a patient from another facility a chart here
column6: a patient who already has a chart at this facility
column8: I am told they are already registered here and nothing is filed

column5: Give a patient from another facility a chart here
column6: a number already assigned to another patient at this facility, in any of its leading-zero or temporary forms
column8: it is refused and names the number

column5: Give a patient from another facility a chart here
column6: I hold the view-only key (AGZVIEWONLY) or not the registration key (AGZMENU)
column7: I open a patient from another facility
column8: I cannot add a chart number here

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: a tribal member
column7: I record eligibility status, classification, tribe of membership, Indian blood quantum, tribe quantum and enrollment number
column8: IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds those values

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: a patient with a second tribe
column7: I add it with its quantum
column8: the OTHER TRIBE multiple of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds that tribe and quantum

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: an eligibility status that needs reasons
column8: the patient's ELIGIBILITY MODIFIERS multiple (#9000001.03401) holds one entry per reason, each pointing at ELIGIBILITY MODIFIERS (#9000030), and no reason twice

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: a classification of Indian or Alaska Native
column7: I save with an eligibility status of ineligible, or a tribe of NON-INDIAN
column8: it is refused and says which value contradicts the other

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: an eligibility status of ineligible, or a classification of non-Indian or other
column7: I save with a tribe other than NON-INDIAN
column8: it is refused and asks for NON-INDIAN

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: a blood quantum that is not a fraction or one of FULL, NONE, UNKNOWN or UNSPECIFIED, or a fraction over 1
column8: it is refused and names the form

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: a tribe of NON-INDIAN
column7: I save a blood quantum other than NONE or UNKNOWN
column8: it is refused; and given any other tribe, a quantum of NONE or UNKNOWN is refused

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: a tribe quantum, or another tribe's quantum, greater than the Indian blood quantum
column8: it is refused

column5: Record tribe, blood quantum and eligibility
column6: another tribe that is the tribe of membership, or listed twice
column8: it is refused

column5: Record the emergency contact and next of kin
column6: a patient
column7: I record an emergency contact's name, relationship, address and phones
column8: PATIENT (#2) holds the emergency contact's name, address and phones and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the relationship; the same holds for the next of kin

column5: Record the emergency contact and next of kin
column6: an emergency contact on file with an address and phones
column7: I change the contact's name and save nothing else
column8: the previous contact's address and phones are cleared, not carried over to the new person

column5: Record the emergency contact and next of kin
column6: a contact name that is not `LAST,FIRST MIDDLE,SUFFIX`, or shorter than 3 characters
column8: it is refused and names the format

column5: Record the emergency contact and next of kin
column6: a relationship, address or phone for a contact but no name
column8: it is refused and asks for the name

column6: a minor patient
column7: I record the father's name, the mother's maiden name, their relationship, phones, employer, email and place of birth
column8: PATIENT (#2) holds the two names and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the rest

column6: a patient with a guardian who is not a parent
column7: I record the guardian's name and relationship, and a second guardian if there is one
column8: IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds each guardian with their relationship and contact details

column6: a guardian's relationship but no name, or a name but no relationship
column8: it is refused and names what is missing

column6: a parent or guardian name that is not `LAST,FIRST MIDDLE,SUFFIX`
column8: it is refused and names the format

column6: a household size of 100 or more, or an income of 0 or of 10,000,000 or more
column8: it is refused

column6: this facility requires the household income
column7: I save without the income or its period
column8: it is refused and names the value

column6: a patient
column7: I record their primary language, preferred language, English proficiency and other languages
column8: the languages multiple of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds a new entry dated today with those values and one line per other language, and earlier entries are kept

column6: a primary or other language of English
column7: I save without an English proficiency, or with a proficiency of not at all
column8: it is refused

column6: a primary language other than English
column7: I save without saying whether an interpreter is needed
column8: it is refused and asks for it

column6: an other language that is the primary language, or listed twice
column8: it is refused

column6: a preferred language that is neither the primary language nor one of the other languages
column8: I am warned and may still save

column5: Record migrant worker and homeless status
column6: a patient who is homeless
column7: I record that with the type
column8: the homeless status multiple of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds a new entry dated today with the status and type, and earlier answers are kept

column5: Record migrant worker and homeless status
column6: a patient who is a migrant worker
column7: I record that with the type
column8: the migrant worker multiple of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds a new entry dated today with the status and type

column5: Record migrant worker and homeless status
column6: a status of homeless or migrant worker
column8: it is refused and asks for the type

column5: Record migrant worker and homeless status
column6: a status of not homeless
column8: the entry is filed without a type

column5: Record the patient's preferred and other names
column6: a patient
column8: IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds it and the patient is listed with it beside their legal name

column5: Record the patient's preferred and other names
column6: a patient who has used other names
column8: the OTHER NAME multiple (#2.01) of PATIENT (#2) holds each of them and a search by one of them lists the patient

column5: Record the patient's preferred and other names
column6: an other name that is not `LAST,FIRST MIDDLE`, or shorter than 3 or longer than 30 characters
column8: it is refused and names the format

column5: Record the patient's preferred and other names
column6: an other name entered in error
column8: the OTHER NAME multiple (#2.01) no longer holds it and the others are unchanged

column5: Record legal sex, gender identity, sexual orientation and pronouns
column6: a patient
column7: I record a legal sex with its effective date and the document that is the source
column8: the legal sex multiple of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds that entry with the date it was entered, and an earlier entry with another effective date is kept

column5: Record legal sex, gender identity, sexual orientation and pronouns
column6: two legal sex entries with the same effective date
column8: it is refused

column5: Record legal sex, gender identity, sexual orientation and pronouns
column6: a patient
column7: I record one or more gender identities and sexual orientations
column8: the gender identity and sexual orientation multiples of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) each hold today's entry with every choice, and an entry from an earlier date is kept

column5: Record legal sex, gender identity, sexual orientation and pronouns
column6: a gender identity, sexual orientation or pronoun of other
column8: it is refused

column5: Record legal sex, gender identity, sexual orientation and pronouns
column6: a patient
column8: IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the pronouns and, for other, the text

column6: a veteran
column7: I record the branch, entry and separation dates, service-connected status, Vietnam service and claim number
column8: PATIENT (#2) holds those values and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds today as the date the veteran information was edited

column6: a veteran with a valid VA card
column7: I record the date a copy was obtained
column8: IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the card as valid with that date; and given no valid card, it holds whether they were told how to obtain one and no copy date

column6: a service entry date after the separation date, or either date in the future or before 1871
column8: it is refused

column6: a claim number that is not 7 or 8 digits
column8: it is refused and names the format

column5: Record the papers the patient signs or receives at the window
column6: a patient
column7: I record that they received the notice of privacy practices on a date and signed the acknowledgement
column8: NOTICE OF PRIVACY PRACTICES (#9000038) holds the patient with those answers, me and today's date

column5: Record the papers the patient signs or receives at the window
column6: a patient who received the notice but did not sign
column8: it is refused and asks for the reason; and given they did not receive it, no acknowledgement or reason is kept

column5: Record the papers the patient signs or receives at the window
column6: a patient
column7: I record the date benefits were assigned
column8: the ASSIGN BENEFITS OBTAINED DATE multiple (#9000001.71) of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds a new entry for that date, and a second entry for the same date is not added

column5: Record the papers the patient signs or receives at the window
column6: a patient
column7: I record the date they signed the release of information
column8: the RELEASE OF INFORMATION multiple (#9000001.03601) of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds an entry for that date

column5: Record the papers the patient signs or receives at the window
column6: an assignment or release date in the future
column8: it is refused

column5: Record the papers the patient signs or receives at the window
column6: this facility's REGISTRATION PARAMETERS (#9009061) make the release of information or the assignment of benefits mandatory
column8: it is refused and names it

column5: Record the papers the patient signs or receives at the window
column6: a patient
column7: I record whether they were granted access to their personal health record on a date, and the date they were given the handout
column8: the PHR access and PHR handout multiples of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) hold those entries, and a second entry for the same date is refused

column5: Record consent to share records with other providers
column6: an adult patient
column7: I record their consent or refusal with the effective date and an expiration date
column8: the sharing consent multiple of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds a new entry with those dates and this facility, and earlier entries are kept unchanged

column5: Record consent to share records with other providers
column6: an effective date in the future, more than five years ago, or before the patient's date of birth
column8: it is refused

column5: Record consent to share records with other providers
column6: an expiration date on or before the effective date
column8: it is refused

column5: Record consent to share records with other providers
column6: a patient under 18
column8: no sharing consent can be recorded for them and none is counted as missing

column6: a patient with a living will
column7: I record the directive with its type and date of entry
column8: ADVANCE DIRECTIVE (#9000040) holds the patient and its date-of-entry multiple holds the directive with that type and date

column6: a patient with no directive
column7: I record that with the reason
column8: the date-of-entry multiple of ADVANCE DIRECTIVE (#9000040) holds the answer with the reason

column6: a directive of the same type already on file for that date
column8: it is refused

column6: a directive with no type, or no directive with no reason, or no date of entry
column8: it is refused and names the value

column6: a directive entered in error
column8: the date-of-entry multiple of ADVANCE DIRECTIVE (#9000040) no longer holds it

column6: a patient
column7: I record a legal document with its type, document number, the date it was added to the file and its effective and end dates
column8: PATIENT'S LEGAL DOCS (#9000034) holds it for the patient with me and today as the entry

column6: no document type or no date added to file
column8: it is refused and names the value

column6: an end date before the effective date
column8: it is refused

column6: a document on file
column7: I correct its dates, or remove it
column8: PATIENT'S LEGAL DOCS (#9000034) holds the corrected dates, or no longer holds it

column6: a patient
column8: the notes word-processing field of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the text, however long

column6: notes on file
column8: IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds no notes for the patient

column6: a registered patient
column7: I change their date of birth, sex, marital status, religion, place of birth, employer or employment status
column8: PATIENT (#2) and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) hold the new values

column6: a registered patient
column7: I record one or more races and ethnicities with how each was collected
column8: the RACE INFORMATION multiple (#2.02) and the ethnicity multiple of PATIENT (#2) hold one entry per race and ethnicity, each pointing at RACE (#10) or ETHNICITY (#10.2), with its collection method

column6: no race or no ethnicity
column8: it is refused and names which

column6: the same race or ethnicity listed twice, or unknown or declined together with another
column8: it is refused

column6: an employer but no employment status
column8: it is refused and asks for the status

column6: a registered patient
column7: I record their industries and occupations
column8: the industry and occupation multiple of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds today's entry with one line per pair, no industry twice, and each with both an industry and an occupation

column6: a social security number already on another patient
column7: I change the patient's number to it
column8: it is refused and nothing is filed

column6: I do not hold the key that shows social security numbers (AGZVIEWSSN)
column8: the number is not shown to me

column6: I hold only the view-only key (AGZVIEWONLY)
column8: I can see the registration and change nothing

column5: Keep the address, phones and email current
column6: a patient with an address on file
column7: I change the street address, city, state, zip code or home phone, with the date they moved
column8: PATIENT (#2) holds the new address and the PREVIOUS MAIL ADDRESSES multiple (#9000001.83) of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the old one, ended on the date they moved

column5: Keep the address, phones and email current
column6: a street address typed with abbreviations, or a post office box or rural route in any of its common forms
column8: I am shown the postal standard form and PATIENT (#2) holds the address in that form

column5: Keep the address, phones and email current
column6: this facility's REGISTRATION PARAMETERS (#9009061) make the street address, city, state or zip code mandatory
column8: it is refused and names the field

column5: Keep the address, phones and email current
column6: a zip code that is not 1 to 10 letters and digits, or a phone shorter than 4 digits
column8: it is refused and names the format

column5: Keep the address, phones and email current
column6: a patient
column7: I change their cell phone, work phone, other phone, email, reminder preference or pharmacy residence
column8: PATIENT (#2) holds the phones and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the rest, and the PREVIOUS EMAIL ADDRESSES multiple (#9000001.82) holds the email that was replaced

column5: Keep the address, phones and email current
column6: an email address that is not in email form
column8: it is refused

column5: Keep the address, phones and email current
column6: a date lived from that is in the future, before 1871 or before the patient's date of birth
column8: it is refused

column5: Record the community, directions to the home, internet access and the address history
column6: a patient who has moved to another community
column7: I record the community and the date moved
column8: the PREVIOUS COMMUNITY multiple (#9000001.51) of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the community under that date, and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds it as the current community when the date is on or after the current one

column5: Record the community, directions to the home, internet access and the address history
column6: a community that was inactive on the date moved
column8: it is refused

column5: Record the community, directions to the home, internet access and the address history
column6: a date moved in the future, before 1871, or before the patient's date of birth, or no community or date
column8: it is refused and names the value

column5: Record the community, directions to the home, internet access and the address history
column6: a patient whose home is hard to find
column8: the location-of-home word-processing field of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds them; and when I clear them, it holds none

column5: Record the community, directions to the home, internet access and the address history
column6: a patient
column7: I record that they can use the internet and from where
column8: the internet access multiple of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds today's answer with each place, and earlier answers are kept

column5: Record the community, directions to the home, internet access and the address history
column6: an answer that they can use the internet
column7: I save without saying from where
column8: it is refused

column5: Record the community, directions to the home, internet access and the address history
column6: a previous address on file
column7: I correct its lines or the dates it was lived at
column8: the PREVIOUS MAIL ADDRESSES multiple (#9000001.83) holds the corrected entry

column5: Record the community, directions to the home, internet access and the address history
column6: a date lived to before the date lived from, or either date in the future or before 1871
column8: it is refused

column5: See what is missing or wrong on a patient's registration
column6: a patient with no privacy notice on file, an address older than the facility allows, or coverage that has lapsed
column8: each error and warning is listed against the section it belongs to, with errors counted apart from warnings

column5: See what is missing or wrong on a patient's registration
column6: an error listed for a missing item
column8: the error is no longer listed

column5: See what is missing or wrong on a patient's registration
column6: a patient under 18
column8: a missing sharing consent is not listed against them

column5: See every document on file and print the face sheet
column6: a patient with a privacy notice, assignment of benefits, release of information, advance directive, legal document, sharing consent, personal health record access, name change and restricted health information on file
column8: each is listed with its date, drawn from NOTICE OF PRIVACY PRACTICES (#9000038), the ASSIGN BENEFITS OBTAINED DATE (#9000001.71) and RELEASE OF INFORMATION (#9000001.03601) multiples, ADVANCE DIRECTIVE (#9000040), PATIENT'S LEGAL DOCS (#9000034), PATIENT NAME CHANGES (#9000033) and RESTRICTED HEALTH INFORMATION (#9000039)

column5: See every document on file and print the face sheet
column6: a patient
column7: I print their face sheet, index card or wrist band
column8: the printout carries the registration as filed in PATIENT (#2) and IHS PATIENT (#9000001) on that day, and nothing is stored

column5: Change or retire a chart number
column6: a patient with a chart at this facility
column8: the HEALTH RECORD NO. multiple (#9000001.41) of IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the new number under this facility

column5: Change or retire a chart number
column6: a number already assigned to another patient at this facility, or not 1 to 6 characters in the chart-number format
column8: it is refused and names the number

column5: Change or retire a chart number
column6: a chart registered in error, sent to archives or inactive
column7: I set that disposition with the date
column8: the HEALTH RECORD NO. multiple (#9000001.41) holds the disposition, a status of inactivated and that date, the patient is listed with that status, and their registration can no longer be edited at this facility

column5: Change or retire a chart number
column6: an inactivated chart
column7: I set the disposition to reactivated or new chart
column8: the HEALTH RECORD NO. multiple (#9000001.41) holds the disposition with no status and no inactivation date, and the registration can be edited again

column5: Change or retire a chart number
column6: I do not hold the registration manager key (AGZMGR)
column8: I cannot change their chart number or disposition

column6: a patient with proof of a new name
column7: I record the new name, the proof provided and the document number
column8: PATIENT (#2) holds the new name, PATIENT NAME CHANGES (#9000033) holds the change with the date, proof and document, and the OTHER NAME multiple (#2.01) holds the former name

column6: no proof provided, or a name that is not `LAST,FIRST MIDDLE` or outside 3 to 30 characters
column8: it is refused and names the value

column6: a name change on file
column7: I correct its proof or document number
column8: PATIENT NAME CHANGES (#9000033) holds the correction and the patient's name is unchanged

column6: I do not hold the registration manager key (AGZMGR)
column8: I cannot change their legal name

column6: a living patient
column7: I record the date and time of death, the state, the certificate number and the preliminary cause
column8: PATIENT (#2) holds the date of death and me as the user who entered it, IHS PATIENT (#9000001) holds the state, certificate number and the date edited, and the patient is listed as deceased

column6: a date of death before the patient's date of birth, or in the future
column8: it is refused

column6: a death on file
column8: the registration can be seen and nothing in it changed

column6: a death entered in error
column8: PATIENT (#2) holds no date of death and the registration can be edited again

column6: I do not hold the registration manager key (AGZMGR)
column8: I cannot record or clear a death

column5: Assign and work a patient record flag
column6: a patient and a flag from PRF NATIONAL FLAG (#26.15) or PRF LOCAL FLAG (#26.11)
column7: I assign it with the owner site, the narrative, who approved it and the review date
column8: PRF ASSIGNMENT (#26.13) holds an active assignment for the patient with those values and the narrative, PRF ASSIGNMENT HISTORY (#26.14) holds a new-assignment action entered by me and approved by that person, and the patient is listed as flagged

column5: Assign and work a patient record flag
column6: a flag already assigned to the patient
column7: I assign the same flag again
column8: it is refused

column5: Assign and work a patient record flag
column6: a flag with a review frequency
column7: I save with a review date before today, after today plus the frequency, or none
column8: it is refused and names the date

column5: Assign and work a patient record flag
column6: no owner site, narrative, approver or flag
column8: it is refused and names the value

column5: Assign and work a patient record flag
column6: an active assignment
column7: I continue or reactivate it with a reason, an approver and a new review date
column8: PRF ASSIGNMENT (#26.13) holds the new review date and an active status, and PRF ASSIGNMENT HISTORY (#26.14) holds that action with the reason

column5: Assign and work a patient record flag
column6: an active assignment
column7: I inactivate it, or mark it entered in error, with a reason and an approver
column8: PRF ASSIGNMENT (#26.13) holds an inactive status and PRF ASSIGNMENT HISTORY (#26.14) holds that action with the reason, and the patient is no longer listed as flagged for it

column5: Assign and work a patient record flag
column6: I do not hold the flag assignment key (DGPF ASSIGNMENT)
column8: I cannot assign a new flag

column5: Track a request to restrict health information
column6: a patient who asks for a restriction
column7: I record it as pending with the date and the reason
column8: RESTRICTED HEALTH INFORMATION (#9000039) holds the patient with that status, reason and date, entered by me today, and the patient is listed as restricted

column5: Track a request to restrict health information
column6: a pending request
column7: I record it as approved with the date and the approving official
column8: RESTRICTED HEALTH INFORMATION (#9000039) holds the approval with that official and date, by me today
